class.name: FoxStatPool
class.brief_description: A resource that manages a dynamic value bounded by a modifiable maximum capacity.
class.description: Combines a [FoxModifiableStat] for the maximum bound and a [FoxBoundedValue] for the current pool. [br][b]Note:[/b] Ensure [member Resource.resource_local_to_scene] is enabled when assigning to multiple instances to prevent shared state.

method.name: get_percent
method.description: Returns the ratio of [member current] to [member max_value] as a value between 0.0 and 1.0.

method.name: add_max_modifier
method.description: Adds a modifier to the maximum capacity.

method.name: pop_max_modifier
method.description: Removes the most recent modifier from the maximum capacity stack.

method.name: clear_max_modifier
method.description: Instantly removes all modifiers matching the given [param id] and [param type] from the maximum capacity.

method.name: clear_all_max_modifiers
method.description: Removes all modifiers, returning the maximum capacity to [member base_max].

method.name: add_flat_max_modifier
method.description: Helper to quickly add a flat modifier to the max capacity.

method.name: add_multiplier_max_modifier
method.description: Helper to quickly add a multiplier modifier to the max capacity.

method.name: pop_flat_max_modifier
method.description: Helper to quickly pop the top flat modifier from the max capacity stack.

method.name: pop_multiplier_max_modifier
method.description: Helper to quickly pop the top multiplier modifier from the max capacity stack.

method.name: clear_flat_max_modifier
method.description: Helper to instantly remove all flat modifiers under a specific ID from the max capacity.

method.name: clear_multiplier_max_modifier
method.description: Helper to instantly remove all multiplier modifiers under a specific ID from the max capacity.

members.member: The current calculated maximum capacity, including all active modifiers.
The current value of the pool. Automatically clamped by the minimum and maximum bounds.

signal.name: updated
signal.description: Emitted when [member current] or the maximum capacity changes.

signal.name: depleted
signal.description: Emitted when [member current] falls below 0.0. [param underflow] contains the absolute value of the excess.

signal.name: saturated
signal.description: Emitted when [member current] exceeds the maximum capacity. [param overflow] contains the excess amount.
